title: Credential Lifecycle & Account Recovery Security Review

observations.evidence: POST /password/reset requires token length 32..512 and password length 12..256; opaque token is hashed before lookup; consumedAt and expiresAt are checked; conditional updateMany claims an unconsumed, unexpired token; password is hashed; all ACTIVE user sessions are revoked; completion audit record is created.
POST /password/forgot returns a generic 202 response intended to prevent account enumeration; comment explicitly says real delivery is disabled until provider configuration.
IP scope limit 5 per 60 minutes and account scope limit 3 per 60 minutes.
PasswordResetToken stores tokenHash (unique), userId, expiresAt, consumedAt, createdAt; userId/expiresAt index exists.
Current forgot-password handler does not issue or persist a reset token and does not dispatch email; provider integration remains disabled.
